Check overlap with known neoantigens

Wei Sun

2025-10-02

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
theme_set(theme_classic())

data_dir   = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_processed_data"
result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"

Read in data

Read in somatic mutations

There are three list 1. all muations that appear at least 5 times 2. those mutations ranked by the number of associated TCRs 3. those identified by cross-validation

cv_fnm = "cv_optimal_pcut_both_uniq_mutations.tsv"
mut_data   = fread(file.path(data_dir, "mutation_info.tsv"))

mut_data[,mutation := paste(Hugo_Symbol, gsub("p.", "", HGVSp_Short), sep = ":")]

Read in known neoantigens

known_neoantigen = fread("../data/konwn_public_neoantigen.csv")
dim(known_neoantigen)

known_neoantigen[,mutation := gsub(":p.", ":", key, fixed = TRUE)]

table(mut_by_cv$key_pro %in% known_neoantigen$mutation)
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##    27     1
table(mut_by_cv$key_pro %in% mut_by_TCR$mutation)
## 
## TRUE 
##   28
table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation)
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##  4583    13
table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30)
##        
##         FALSE TRUE
##   FALSE  4223  360
##   TRUE      2   11
table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10)
##        
##         FALSE TRUE
##   FALSE  4147  436
##   TRUE      2   11
tb0 = table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% mut_by_cv$key_pro, 
            mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10)

tb1 = table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, 
            mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10)

tb2 = table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, 
            mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 40 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 20)

c0 = chisq.test(tb0)
## Warning in chisq.test(tb0): Chi-squared approximation may be incorrect
c1 = chisq.test(tb1)
## Warning in chisq.test(tb1): Chi-squared approximation may be incorrect
c2 = chisq.test(tb2)
## Warning in chisq.test(tb2): Chi-squared approximation may be incorrect

tapply(mut_by_TCR$Freq, mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10, summary)
## $`FALSE`
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
##   5.000   5.000   6.000   6.864   7.000 385.000 
## 
## $`TRUE`
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
##    5.00    9.00   14.00   27.09   25.00  558.00
tapply(mut_by_TCR$Freq, mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10, 
       function(v){table(v > 20)})
## $`FALSE`
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##  4292    40 
## 
## $`TRUE`
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##   177    87
tapply(mut_by_TCR$Freq, mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, 
       function(v){table(v > 20)})
## $`FALSE`
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##  4468   115 
## 
## $`TRUE`
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##     1    12
mut_by_TCR[,neoantigen := mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation]

fit <- lm(log10(nTCRA+nTCRB)  ~  neoantigen + log10(Freq),
           data = mut_by_TCR)
summary(fit)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = log10(nTCRA + nTCRB) ~ neoantigen + log10(Freq), 
##     data = mut_by_TCR)
## 
## Residuals:
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -1.34573 -0.18102  0.01527  0.19934  0.97820 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)     0.37372    0.02067  18.084  < 2e-16 ***
## neoantigenTRUE -0.34092    0.08600  -3.964 7.48e-05 ***
## log10(Freq)     0.93337    0.02445  38.168  < 2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.2955 on 4593 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.2484, Adjusted R-squared:  0.248 
## F-statistic: 758.8 on 2 and 4593 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16
mut_by_TCR20 = mut_by_TCR[Freq > 20,]
dim(mut_by_TCR20)
## [1] 127  11
mut_by_TCR20[1:2,]
## Key: <mutation, Variant_Classification, Freq>
##            mutation Variant_Classification  Freq nTCRA nTCRB              key
##              <char>                 <char> <int> <int> <int>           <char>
## 1: ACVR2A:K437Rfs*5        Frame_Shift_Del    69    41    38  2:148683686:A:-
## 2:   ADD3:K701Rfs*8        Frame_Shift_Del    25    66    21 10:111893350:A:-
##    Hugo_Symbol      HGVSc             HGVSp HGVSp_Short neoantigen
##         <char>     <char>            <char>      <char>     <lgcl>
## 1:      ACVR2A c.1310delA p.Lys437ArgfsTer5 p.K437Rfs*5      FALSE
## 2:        ADD3 c.2102delA p.Lys701ArgfsTer8 p.K701Rfs*8      FALSE
table(mut_by_TCR20$Freq > 100)
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##   115    12
# create frequency group variable
mut_by_TCR20 <- mut_by_TCR20 %>%
  mutate(FreqGroup = ifelse(Freq > 100, "Freq > 100", "Freq ≤ 100"))

p <- ggplot(mut_by_TCR20, aes(x = FreqGroup, 
                              y = log10(nTCRA + nTCRB), 
                              fill = neoantigen)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.7),
              alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "red"),
                    labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  labs(
    x = "Frequency group",
    y = "log10(nTCRA + nTCRB)",
    fill = "Neoantigen"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = neoantigen), 
                     method = "wilcox.test", 
                     label = "p.format", 
                     label.y = max(log10(mut_by_TCR20$nTCRA + mut_by_TCR20$nTCRB)) - 0.02)

print(p)

ggplot(mut_by_TCR20, aes(x = log10(Freq), y = log10(nTCRA + nTCRB), 
                         color = neoantigen)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "red")) +
  labs(
    x = "log10(Frequency)",
    y = "log10(nTCRA + nTCRB)",
    color = "Neoantigen"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
